Description: Number of lattice points for the real space integration grid in the x direction. By default, nx = ny = nz

Input value for the buffer dimension. Note that, in the complex code, the buffer dimension is automatically doubled. In this case, consider decreasing the buffer dimension if you have a memory problem.

Default:
- if no input

  + ``0.d0``

- ignore input

  + ``cellscale(1)/nx`` if iespbc is .true.
Description: Space (a.u.) for an open system in the x direction; for periodic systems, it is chosen as the cell parameter in the same direction and need not be specified. By default, ax = ay = az

Default:
- if no input

  + ``ax``

- ignore input

  + ``cellscale(2)/ny`` if iespbc is .true.

- if no input

  + ``ay``

-  ignore input

  + ``cellscale(3)/nz`` if iespbc is .true.
